title: Clay Mathematics Institute says the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem has "apparently been settled"
summary: The Clay Mathematics Institute says the Navier-Stokes problem, one of seven Millennium Prize Problems worth $1 million each, has "apparently been settled." A formal review is now underway. The article Clay Mathematics Institute says the Navier-Stokes Millennium Prize Problem has "apparently been settled" appeared first on The Decoder .
